decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a cheap complement to the core flooring range, and with no sign of failure, holding the option open costs little while demand evidence builds.
The maintenance oil line anchors the surface-treatment offer for oiled floors, and its low carrying cost and steady fit with the core business justify keeping it.
Care products for oiled floors cost little to keep listed and support customer relationships, and the results so far give no reason to abandon this option.
The moisture-protection underlay is a functional accessory installers need, so it keeps upside at minimal holding cost.
The high-density foam underlay may overlap with the other underlay, but its low carrying cost and still unresolved demand favour keeping it another year before any pruning.
